hook: Progression-free sets in any finite group are now bounded by a stronger size limit.
summary: The paper transfers sharp bounds on 3-term-progression-free sets from abelian groups to class 2 nilpotent groups and then to all finite groups. Combining this with a recent result by Raghavan gives a bound of |G| times exp(-c (log|G|)^(1/6) / (loglog|G|)^(1/3)). It is an upper bound only, and likely not tight.
title: Progression-free sets in class $2$ and arbitrary finite groups
